utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning all. Tuesday third, quick stand-up and then I'll let you crack on. Everyone alright?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, not bad. Bit grim out there though, isn't it. Proper sideways rain again.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Standard February.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I got soaked just from car park to door.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm. Weekend's meant to be a bit brighter though, so if it holds I might actually get out in the garden for once.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Brave.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: You'll need waders, not gardening gloves.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, before we become the Met Office. Sarah, nights?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quiet enough overall. Just an observation really, noticed the line 3 screw was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so nothing for today off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, noted. Keep an eye on it, but yeah, not a job from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Han, you next.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Er, quality-wise all fine on the morning samples. And before I forget, that football last night was awful. Well, unless you support them, I suppose.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Oh it was brilliant, what you on about?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Rubbish. They were hanging on for dear life second half.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Can we not do VAR at eight in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Please, spare me. Anything real, Han?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. Blocker on the GT1 fuel valve still, still waiting on parts for the GT1 fuel valve, nothing we can do until they arrive, so that's not moving today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, parked till stores gets something through. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I can run a function test on the boiler safety valve. I'll do that first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Get that booked in.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yesterday, I tested the booster pump yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done and gone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Procurement side, couple of deliveries due before lunch. Nothing dramatic.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I need you on something though, Jamie Brennan — sort the permit to work and isolation for the turbine two water valve. That one's safety critical, straight away. I need it ready tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the turbine two water valve, tomorrow at 9:30. I'll get on that straight away.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. And second one, Jamie — can you go to Tollgate Water Treatment Works to pick up the replacement parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll go to Tollgate Water Treatment Works to pick up the replacement parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Spot on.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing major from me. Panels all behaving. I still want a look at that nuisance trip on line two when we get chance, but not today, no immediate action.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grace?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Two from me. The water booster's been a bit noisy on and off, not enough to panic about but it needs doing this week — I'll take vibration readings on the water booster by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And also, because of the planned job there, it needs doing this week, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the main isolation valve this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, thanks Grace.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fi?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Scheduling-wise, just so you know, I signed off the inspection on the GT2 bearing on Tuesday, so that's already complete.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And blocker-wise, can't get to the line 3 barrel until production gives us a window, so that's stuck for now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, not today on that, we've got no gap till at least late shift.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, leave line 3 barrel where it is then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One small one on utilities: swap the filter on the air dryer. It's low priority, first thing tomorrow. Han, can you pick that up?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Uh, not really. I've got the boiler safety valve first thing tomorrow and then audits stacked after that. I won't get near it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair. Fi, can you take it instead?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll swap the filter on the air dryer first thing tomorrow. Low priority, so if nothing falls over before then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's fine, as long as it's done.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anything else knocking about that actually needs agreeing today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, that's me. Just the weather, again. If it snows on top of this lot I'm working from my bed.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Production supervisor'll love that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Absolutely not.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: He says that, but he'd do the same.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I would not.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mic off, camera off, "sorry bad connection".

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheek. Right, recapping so nobody wriggles out of it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Han's got the function test on the boiler safety valve first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grace is taking vibration readings on the water booster by the end of the week, and updating the risk assessment for work on the main isolation valve this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan is sorting the permit to work and isolation for the turbine two water valve — that one's safety critical, straight away — for tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, on it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And Jamie's going to Tollgate Water Treatment Works to pick up the replacement parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's me, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fi's swapping the filter on the air dryer first thing tomorrow, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Blocked stuff stays blocked: GT1 fuel valve waiting on parts, line 3 barrel waiting on a production window. Done stuff stays done: booster pump tested, GT2 bearing inspection signed off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And line 3 screw was just a watch item on nights, not a fresh job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly that. Anything urgent before we break?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nope.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: All set.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, thanks all.
